This blog originated as an assignment for my course at Emerson College, *VM402-09 Soundtracks: Music & Audiovisual Media*, taught in Spring 2019. The last two videos were as demos for the assignment. I’ve since added several other projects of my own, along with a couple of other examples that exemplify the alternate-soundtrack concept.

Dorian ♭2 is the second mode of the melodic minor scale.

Martin Roberts\
2019-26
